title: Split Queue file override drawer modules
summary: Split the Queue file override drawer classic script into focused state, form, series, tracks, API, and focus modules while keeping fileOverrides.drawer.js as the public registration facade.
reason: The drawer mixed state, form population, exact-track selectors, series preview/apply, focus trapping, and backend API calls in one large file. The split preserves script-order behavior and keeps backend-owned preview/save authority intact.
behavior_before: Queue file override drawer behavior lived in one monolithic classic script that owned state, form payloads, track controls, series preview/apply, focus handling, and save/clear calls.
behavior_after: The same drawer behavior is assembled through focused classic-script child modules loaded before the facade; backend routes, payload shapes, route preview authority, series apply confirmation, and public registration remain unchanged.
manual_validation: PYTHONPATH=src bundled-python -m unittest tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_web_static tests.webview.test_webview_frontend_mutation_boundary - failed: unrelated subtitle QA routes are missing static Web/Tauri references
PYTHONPATH=src bundled-python file override drawer static subset - passed
npm run webview:lint:budget:check - failed: pre-existing complexity budget drift remains 92 > 91
rollback_plan: Restore the prior monolithic fileOverrides.drawer.js, remove the six child scripts from index.html, and revert the static route ownership/test updates.
notes: Planned behavior-preserving split of Queue file override drawer classic scripts.
